name: Please Be Solved Vancouver 2024

venue.name: [University of British Columbia](https://www.ubc.ca/)
venue.details: Irving K Barber Learning Centre, Room 155

information:
**Please review all of the tabs listed on this website**. This competition **ONLY HAS BLINDFOLDED EVENTS**, and is **NOT A REGULAR COMPETITION**. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so please be ready for each event/round **about 30 minutes in advance**, just in case (we will not start the first event early).

* Join the [**Speedcubing Canada mailing list**](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) for competition announcements.
* Join the [**Vancouver Facebook group**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494/?ref=share) for BC discussion/announcements.
* Join the [**PNW Facebook group**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085/?ref=share) for PNW discussion/announcements.

**Notice of filming and photography**: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

This is on the same day as [FMC Canada 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2024), in the same room.
